mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS has declined over the prior month, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate falls below 3.5% for two consecutive months, it indicates a tight labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE has been below 3.5% for two consecutive months, or the Rank IC is below 0.05 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and a rise in retail sales (RSAFS) signals a shift in consumer spending patterns toward durable goods, which typically precedes stronger corporate revenue growth and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where HOUST declines and RSAFS rises, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: In periods of strong industrial production growth (INDPRO > 105.0), a decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates labor market tightening that improves supply chain efficiency and corporate profit margins, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO > 105.0 and UNRATE declines, or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year change in CPI (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 3.0%, it signals persistent inflation that triggers a monetary policy tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors price in higher interest rates.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0%, or the Rank IC is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in retail sales (RSAFS) over the past three months indicates robust consumer spending that supports corporate revenue growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where RSAFS has increased for three consecutive months, or the Rank IC is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: In a low unemployment regime (UNRATE < 4.0%), a concurrent increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) above 200,000 jobs signals accelerating labor market strength that boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE < 4.0% and PAYEMS increases above 200,000, or the Rank IC is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100.0 for two consecutive months, it signals a manufacturing slowdown that reduces corporate earnings growth, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO < 100.0 for two consecutive months, or the Rank IC is below 0.05.
